note: Canon Quirks: their class (and Quirk Factor, when listed) are fixed on a card that claims them. Keyed by claim name (case and punctuation ignored). 'added' ones are new claimables (migration 20261126100000_more_canon_quirks.sql) with a category and slot count staff can change.

Creation.blurb: Creates any non-living object from the lipids in the body, as long as the user knows its molecular structure.

Hardening.blurb: Hardens the skin into a sharp, rock-like armor that blocks attacks and makes every strike a weapon.

Engine.blurb: Engines in the calves give bursts of incredible running speed.

Zero Gravity.blurb: Touching something with all five fingertips cancels its gravity; too much makes the user nauseous.

Frog.blurb: Does anything a frog can: a long tongue, wall-climbing, leaping, camouflage and toxic mucus.

Dark Shadow.factor: A sentient shadow living in the body
Dark Shadow.blurb: A sentient shadow creature that fights alongside the user, stronger and wilder in the dark.

Invisibility.blurb: The user's body is permanently invisible and can bend light around it.

Acid.blurb: Secretes acid from the skin, from corrosive to slippery, and can control how strong it is.

Tape.blurb: Shoots and reels in strong tape from the elbows.

Earphone Jack.blurb: Earlobe jacks that send the user's heartbeat as shockwaves and pick up faint sounds.

Navel Laser.blurb: Fires a sparkling laser from the navel; overuse upsets the stomach.

Pop Off.blurb: Pulls sticky spheres off the scalp that stick to anything but the user.

Tail.blurb: A large, strong tail for martial arts, balance and climbing.

Anivoice.blurb: Talks to animals and can ask them for help.

Dupli-Arms.blurb: Tentacles on the arms that can grow copies of any body part.

Sugar Rush.blurb: Eating sugar multiplies the user's strength for a few minutes, then dulls the mind.

Steel.blurb: Turns the body to steel, getting stronger the more iron the user has eaten.

Vines.blurb: Thorny vines for hair that the user controls and can regrow by drinking water and sunbathing.

Big Fist.blurb: Enlarges the hands to giant size for powerful strikes and grabs.

Gigantification.blurb: Grows the whole body to giant size, but only to one fixed size.

Brainwashing.blurb: Anyone who answers the user is put under mind control until struck hard enough to snap out of it.

Fat Absorption.blurb: Sinks attacks into the user's body fat, then burns the fat for a huge burst of strength.

Voice.blurb: A voice loud enough to deafen and knock back anything in front of the user.

Lizard.blurb: Anything a lizard can do: wall-climbing, a tail and regenerating lost body parts.

Magnetism.blurb: Magnetizes people near the user, pulling or pushing them depending on their sex.

Compress.blurb: Compresses anything the user touches into a small marble, and releases it with a snap.

Muscle Augmentation.blurb: Grows extra muscle fibers that greatly increase strength, speed and defense.

Permeation.blurb: Lets the user pass through anything, phasing in and out of solid matter.

Fierce Wings.blurb: Large wings of feathers the user can control one by one: flight, blades and rescues at once.

Foresight.blurb: After touching someone and meeting their eyes, the user can see their future for an hour.

Transform.blurb: Drinking someone's blood lets the user turn into a perfect copy of them.

Double.blurb: Makes copies of anything the user has measured, people included.

Rewind.blurb: Rewinds a living thing's body to an earlier state, healing it or undoing it completely.
